source.mainFunction:
[비타민C] ① 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요 ② 철의 흡수에 필요 ③ 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
[비타민E] 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
[비타민B6] ① 단백질 및 아미노산 이용에 필요 ② 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
[판토텐산] 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요
[비타민B1] 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요
[비타민B2] 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
[비타민B12] 정상적인 엽산 대사에 필요

② 비타민C : 표시량(1,000 mg/2.5 g)의 80~150%
③ 비타민E : 표시량(11 mg α-TE/2.5 g)의 80~150%
④ 비타민B6 : 표시량(4.5 mg/2.5 g)의 80~150%

⑥ 비타민B1 : 표시량(3.6 mg/2.5 g)의 80~180%  
⑦ 비타민B2 : 표시량(4.2 mg/2.5 g)의 80~180%

source.caution:
① 알레르기 체질이신 경우 성분을 확인 한 후 섭취여부를 결정하여야 함
[판토텐산/비타민B1/비타민B2/비타민B12]

Health Functional FoodVitamin B1 3.6mgVitamin B12 2.4μgVitamin B2 4.2mgVitamin B6 4.5mgVitamin C 1000mgVitamin E 11mgPantothenic acid 5mgOnce a day

데일리 멀티비타백(Daily Multivitamin BEC)Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Pantothenic acid

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 3.6mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 4.2mg of Vitamin B2, 4.5mg of Vitamin B6, 1000mg of Vitamin C, 11mg of Vitamin E, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 3.6mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 4.2mg Vitamin B2, 4.5mg Vitamin B6, 1000mg Vitamin C, 11mg Vitamin E, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per serving

Labelled standard

Vitamin B1 labelled (3.6mg / 2.5g), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 2.5g), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (4.2mg / 2.5g), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (4.5mg / 2.5g), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (1000mg / 2.5g), 80~150%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 2.5g), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 2.5g), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 노란 하양색의 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘한 곳에 보관 및 유통(실온)

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
